title: SPA/72/2009 of UNION OF INDIA and OTHERS Vs JAWAHAR SINGH

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Special Appeal No. 72 of 2009
Union of India and others .............. Appellants

Present: None appears for the appellants.
 Mr. Lalit Belwal, Advocate for the respondent.

Coram: Hon'ble Barin Ghosh, C.J.
 Hon'ble Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.
BARIN GHOSH, C.J. (Oral)
 On 16th September, 2010, it was brought to the notice
of this Court that the sole respondent has died. This Court,
accordingly, directed de-listing of the matter with a further
direction that in the event within three months from 16th
September, 2010, no step is taken, the appeal shall stand
dismissed without reference to a Bench. Accordingly, an
application was filed stating that the sole respondent has died
leaving him surviving his wife Dharma Devi, his father Trilok
Singh and his mother Smt. Bishna Devi. Since the wife and the
mother were entitled to inherit the sole respondent, they were
substituted in place of the sole respondent. Subsequently, another
application was filed stating that the wife and the mother of the
sole respondent have been reported to be dead. In those
circumstances, steps were taken to substitute the brother of the
sole respondent. The counsel for the brother, on notice, appeared
and submitted that the sole respondent has died leaving two sons
surviving. In those circumstances, the application seeking to
substitute the brother was dismissed with liberty to the appellants
to file appropriate application. This order was passed on 31st July,
2013. Neither any application has been filed, nor any step has

2
been taken to bring on record the heirs and legal representatives of
the sole respondent or of the substituted respondents.
 The appeal, accordingly, stands abated.

(Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.) (Barin Ghosh, C.J.)
 27.08.2013 27.08.2013
P. Singh
